raw_resume.summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience building scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices for fintech payments. Seeking the Software Development Engineer II role to deepen expertise in distributed systems, design patterns, and system architecture.

bullets: Reduced p95 latency of the settlement API from 800 ms to 350 ms by adding Redis caching.
Split the monolithic payouts module into 4 Spring Boot microservices communicating over REST.
Mentored 2 junior engineers and conducted code reviews in 2-week Agile sprints.
Implemented JPA/Hibernate repositories and MySQL schema changes for the merchant onboarding service.
Automated nightly reconciliation reports, saving the operations team 6 hours per week.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with distributed systems concepts (consensus, eventual consistency, partitioning) and document them in a project or role description.
Study and apply design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy, etc.) in your microservices work, then highlight pattern usage in your resume bullets.
Deepen algorithmic problem-solving skills through competitive programming or system design interviews; mention complexity analysis or optimisation in future roles.
Lead the design and architecture of a new system end-to-end, documenting trade-offs and scaling decisions to strengthen your 2+ years of design/architecture requirement.
raw_resume.growth_note: You meet the 3+ years professional experience requirement and have strong microservices and backend fundamentals. However, the JD emphasises distributed systems, algorithms, and design patterns as core competencies. Your resume currently demonstrates only code review from the curated keywords. To strengthen your candidacy, gain explicit experience with distributed system design, document algorithmic optimisations, and lead architectural decisions in your next role.
